kinyarwanda: Fotora mubazi y'amazi yawe, genzura imibare, maze wishyure ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money. Bifata nk'umunota umwe.

kinyarwanda: Buri fagitire igereranywa n'ibyo usanzwe ukoresha

kinyarwanda: Umukozi wa WASAC yakigenzuye. Fagitire yawe irateguwe.

kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza igipimo giheruka. Ohereza indi foto y'imibare.
